title: Sources
subtitle: Connect Git repositories to browse reusable catalog and inventory content.
add_hint: Paste the repository URL and choose its branch. The connected backend will read the catalog from Git.
rotate_hint: Update the credential stored on the connected backend. Public repositories can be read without a token.
oauth_out_of_scope: Interactive OAuth is not yet wired up. Use the self-hosted tab with a personal access token.
empty_desc: Start with the public Range42 catalog above, or connect your own repository.
token_hint: Public repositories need no token. For a private repository, provide a token with read access; it is saved on the backend.
invalid_repo_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS repository URL with an owner and repository. Remove credentials, query parameters and file or branch paths.
invalid_branch: Enter a valid Git branch name.
default_description: Start with the shared Range42 repository for infrastructure components, Ansible roles and container definitions. Connect it once, then refresh to discover its catalog entries.
working: Reading the repository and checking catalog entries…
action_failed: The source action could not be completed.
use_public_access: Remove token and use public access
no_repositories: No repository is bound to this source. Reconnect it using the full repository URL.
no_entries: No supported catalog manifests were found on this branch.
